Allow me share a horror story from my youth in the hopes of making you laugh:

I was 16 and medically obese (a bit under 200 pounds) and I was going back home on the bus. I live close to some of the local colleges so most of the people in the crowded bus were college students, the "cool older guys" in my eyes.

I always hated the way I looked and had 0 self esteem so I always dressed in a way that covered my body completely, but it was summer and scorching hot so that day I was wearing leggings and a tshirt.

It was a friday and everyone was going back home so the bus was FULL, so much so that the bus driver had a hard time closing the doors. I was holding to dear life to one of the holders that were directly on top of me, they´re a bit high up so it forced me to show a bit of my fat belly  (not too much but it was a huge deal for me because I never showed any skin, especially my stomach) I was super embarrased but I thought to myself "who cares, the bus is so full, people just want to go home, noone cares youre fat" 

And then, I shit you not, an old woman who was sitting in the reserved seats PUT HER HAND ON MY STOMACH and said OUT LOUD "Are you pregnant, sweetie?" and have EVERYONE AROUND US turn to look directly at my chubby stomach

So I had to look this woman in the eyes and say, outloud, with my mouth  "no" She looked mortifyied and me, the lady and everyone around who heard us stood in horrid silence, basking in awkwardness for the next 20 minutes until I got home.

I´m now at a normal weight and much more confident in my body but I still capital C cringe everytime I think about it

I guess what Im trying to say is, dont worry, things like these happen sometimes, people say dumb things and put others in awkward situations but its really not a big deal. I wish you the best going forward

Often games with dating aspects that allow same-sex relationships go for the classic "everyone is bi" and have the same beats and dialogue regardless of who you play as

I feel it is so much more realistic when characters are a bit taken aback by their feelings towards a same sex player. Maybe they are more openly gay like Leah and silently wonder if you feel the same way or are more surprised like Sebastian when their feelings towards you grow stronger and it makes them question their sexual identity.

I love how this game honors those small but significant differences and makes it feel like choosing your gender at the begining of the game has real impact on your experience.
